denorm.name: Activity Denormalization
denorm.problem: Profile loads 30-60s: O(n²) scanning all posts
denorm.solution: Denormalize: write to activities collection on every action. Single orderBy query aggregates.
denorm.tradeoff: Write-light ops now heavier, query-light ops free
denorm.antipattern: Don't aggregate on read; aggregate at source

bridge.name: Multi-Provider Bridge Pattern
bridge.problem: Monolithic AI (Copilot) → can't switch providers or extend
bridge.solution: Abstract class: send_state(s) → wait_response() → read_response(). Concrete per provider (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot).
bridge.factory: Switch via config.json, not code changes

confidence.name: Confidence-Based Gating
confidence.problem: Unreliable automation → user doesn't trust it
confidence.principle: Transparency > omniscience. Report both capability and reliability.
confidence.learner: Don't try high-confidence on low-reliable UI types

stateFiles.name: State File Protocol (Beat Clipboard)
stateFiles.solution: ai_input.json + ai_output.json on disk. Read/write via file system.
stateFiles.schema: ai_input: {goal, instructions, turn, screen, detections, available_tools}

polling.name: Adaptive Polling Over Fixed Wait
polling.problem: Fixed 10s timeout wastes fast responses, kills slow reasoning
polling.solution: Poll every 1s, return when ready, max 15min safeguard
polling.adaptive: Fast AI: return in 5s. Slow AI: wait full 60s. Both successful.
polling.principle: Adapt to reality, not force to schedule

visionTiers.name: Layered Vision Detection (No Mandated Images)
visionTiers.tier2: Generic Python (colors, text, OCR, grids): 75-90%, free, extensible
visionTiers.cost: Default $0.001/turn via detection, avoids 10-100x vision API cost

antipatterns.desc: Embed image in prompt as base64
antipatterns.fix: Never. Use binary clipboard or file refs.

Use newest Python for data packages

overflow_230k.fix: Remove all base64 from signal files. Use binary transport or file refs.
overflow_230k.learned: Image delivery can't be text-encoded. Use clipboard (Windows bmp) or visual in editor.

import_mime.symptom: MIME type error, module not found
import_mime.root: Path depth calculation wrong (counted 2 levels instead of 3)

py_wheels.symptom: pip install fails: pre-built wheels don't exist
py_wheels.root: Python 3.13 too new; wheel builders haven't caught up
py_wheels.fix: Use Python 3.12 or earlier. No manual override.
py_wheels.learned: Ecosystem maturity lags 1-2 versions behind latest Python.

ai_loop.symptom: AI repeats same command 5 times, doesn't see changed state
ai_loop.root: No feedback in state JSON; screenshot unchanged between turns
ai_loop.fix: Add state.recent_actions + state.action_feedback fields. Include execution results.

automation_chaos.symptom: Automation fails on news feed, social media, chat UIs
automation_chaos.root: Excessive target ambiguity; AI reasoning loop explodes (10K+ tokens)
automation_chaos.fix: Don't automate chaotic UIs. Whitelist forms, spreadsheets, terminals only.
automation_chaos.learned: Reliability is UI-structure property, not fixable via more reasoning.

window_focus.symptom: Target window doesn't come to foreground; focus stays on calling app
window_focus.root: Using pygetwindow.activate() which fails on Windows minimized windows

decisions.modularityVsRobustness: Orthogonal, not tradeoffs. Handy1 monolithic=robust. Handy2 modular=broken. Handy3 modular+robust via bridge+state_files.
decisions.visionStrategy: Tier1 detection first (99%, $0) → Tier2 (75-90%, $0) → Tier3 AI optional (50 tokens). Never mandate images.
decisions.safetyModel: Confidence gating + human review + audit trail. Not 'prevent errors' but 'surface & reverse errors'.
decisions.deployStrategy: GitHub-native (Actions → Firebase CDN). Fast, transparent, repeatable.
decisions.aiProviders: Claude API (best, native vision) as default. ChatGPT API (equivalent). Copilot (visual in editor). Factory pattern for switching.
decisions.dataSchema: Denormalize at write time (activities subcoll), query at read time (single orderBy).
decisions.uiAutomation: Forms/sheets/terminals: reliable. Feeds/chat/dynamic: unreliable by structure. Whitelist, don't generalize.

invariants: activities collection must have {userId, contentId, type, metadata, ts} schema
ai_input.json MUST NOT contain base64 images
path depths from src/features/*/page.js MUST be ../../../ (exactly 3)
AI response timeout MUST be >= 60s for reasoning tasks
Confidence <40% MUST prompt user, <30% MUST refuse
Handy3 must support >= 3 AI providers via bridge pattern
Vision detection MUST attempt tier1+tier2 before tier3 (AI fallback)
Window focus MUST use Win32 SetForegroundWindow on Windows
State files MUST be <50KB to prevent token overflow

principles.transparency: Report reliability as honestly as capability. User can make informed decision.
principles.layering: Free stuff first (detection), paid stuff last (AI vision). Order by cost.
principles.immutability: State files are audit trail. Keep for debugging, don't mutate.
principles.extensibility: Bridge pattern + config = add provider without code change.
principles.graceful: Fail safely: refuse low-confidence action, not guess.
principles.compression: Denormalize write, query read. Fast reads beat slow writes at scale.

capabilities.✓ form_filling: 94% reliable. Labeled inputs, clear next button.
capabilities.✗ chat_ui: 45% reliable. Modal complexity, unclear send state.

lessons: Monolithic code survives production; modular code fails at design time. Handy1 vs Handy2.
Base64 images in text are invisible killers (230K+ overflow). Architect around it from start.
File protocols beat UI automation 10:1. More reliable, more portable, more debuggable.
Three tiers beat zero tiers. Free detection → Cost-saving AI fallback.
Feedback loop worth 1000 tokens of reasoning. AI needs to see results of actions.
Confidence scoring easy to add, impossible to remove. Bake in from day 1.
Python version compatibility requires 1-2 year ecosystem lag assumption.
UI clarity determines automation reliability more than AI capability.
Denormalization is a write-time tradeoff that pays off at read time.
Bridge pattern enables extensibility; hardcoding prevents it. Both feel equivalent until year 2.
Transparency about failures builds trust more than hiding them.
Lazy loading saved 50x perceived latency (image doesn't render until needed).
Single source of truth for prompts; duplication erases half the edits.

performance_gains.deployment: Manual upload → GitHub Actions CDN (1-2min auto)

code_patterns.denorm_write: On any action: ActivityService.log(userId, contentId, type, metadata)
code_patterns.confidence: If score < 40: promptUser(); if score < 30: return(REFUSE);
code_patterns.bridge_add: class BridgeNewProvider extends BridgeBase; implement send_state(), wait_response(), read_response()
code_patterns.state_file: JSON <50KB, fields: goal, detections, available_tools, recent_actions, action_feedback

decision_trees.when_automation_fails: Is UI unambiguous? NO→whitelist. YES→check confidence. <40%→prompt. <30%→refuse. ≥70%→execute.
decision_trees.when_load_slow: Is loadActivity() using orderBy? NO→migrate. YES→check index. Is index on activities? NO→create.
decision_trees.when_import_fails: Count ../ from file. Should be 3. Else: adjust.
decision_trees.when_ai_repeats: Did state include feedback? NO→add. YES→is feedback stale? YES→refresh.
decision_trees.when_pip_fails: Python version? 3.13→downgrade to 3.12. Else→check wheels on PyPI.

audit_requirements: Every ai_input.json must include: turn number, timestamp, user action, available tools
Every ai_output.json must include: reasoning summary, command count, confidence scores
Every state transition must log: before_state, action, after_state, user_approved
Every error must include: error type, context (UI type, task), recovery action
Session lifecycle: start task → N turns → end task → archive to JSON
Retention: Keep all state files for 30 days minimum (audit trail)

queries: Is every read query using an index?
Is orderBy on first query (not secondary)?
vision: Did you check for free Tier1/Tier2 before Tier3?
automation: Did you check UI reliability? Form=94%, Chat=45%?
deployment: Did you test in prod-like environment?
code: Did you use bridge pattern for extensibility?
